main.description: A note about a place: what it is like, and optionally how good it is. Lives in a permissioned space, readable only by that space's members.

location.description: Where the note is about. Required even when 'place' is set, so a note about a bench or a view works like one about a shop.

place.description: The OpenStreetMap feature this note is about, when it is about a business. What gathers several people's notes onto one place.

rating.description: Optional rating. Its presence is what makes a note a review.

osmPlace.description: A reference to an OpenStreetMap feature. Local to this lexicon because the community location lexicons cover Foursquare, H3, coordinates and addresses, but nothing for OSM. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

osmId.description: The OSM element id, as a string to avoid 53-bit float truncation.
